'''The Mor'shan Rampart'''{{coords|48|6|Barrens}} lies at the northern terminus of the [[Gold Road]] in [[the Barrens]]. This makeshift defensive post was built to withstand the push of [[Alliance]] forces into the [[Barrens]] from [[Ashenvale]] to the north. There is, however, a damaged portion unguarded by the Horde to the east of the main post. It is mostly abandoned, but still serves as a makeshift launching point for raids on the [[Night Elf]] town of [[Astranaar]].
